issues.message: Keterkaitan otomatis: nama berkas, deskripsi berkas, kategori "Apollo Belvedere before restoration in 2020–2024 (Vatican Museums)", dipakai di en.wikipedia.org: Apollo. Cek visual tetap diperlukan.

claims.statement: Apollo is an Olympian god of ancient Greek religion and myth whose functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto, twin of Artemis.
claims.statement_id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto, saudara kembar Artemis.
claims.quote: Apollo is one of the Olympian deities in ancient Greek religion and mythology. His numerous functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry, and archery. He is the son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, goddess of the hunt.

claims.statement: As patron of Delphi, Apollo is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and his oracles were often consulted.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi, Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk.
claims.quote: As the patron deity of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo is an oracular god—the prophetic deity of the Delphic Oracle and the deity of ritual purification. His oracles were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

claims.statement: Apollo was seen as a helper and averter of evil (Alexicacus), linked with medicine directly or via his son Asclepius; he delivered people from epidemics but could also bring disease with his arrows.
claims.statement_id: Apollo dipandang sebagai dewa penolong dan penolak kejahatan (Alexicacus), dikaitkan dengan pengobatan secara langsung atau melalui putranya Asclepius; ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan penyakit dengan panahnya.
claims.quote: He was in general seen as the god who affords help and wards off evil, and is referred to as Alexicacus, the "averter of evil". Medicine and healing are associated with Apollo, whether through the god himself or mediated through his son Asclepius. Apollo delivered people from epidemics, yet he is also a god who could bring ill health and deadly plague with his arrows.

claims.statement: As god of mousike Apollo presides over all music, song, dance and poetry; he is the inventor of string music and a frequent companion of the Muses.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi; ia penemu musik dawai dan sering menjadi pendamping para Muse.
claims.quote: As the god of mousike, Apollo presides over all music, songs, dance, and poetry. He is the inventor of string-music and the frequent companion of the Muses

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young, depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) adalah dewa Olimpus nubuat dan orakel, musik, lagu dan puisi, panahan, penyembuhan, wabah dan penyakit, serta perlindungan anak muda; ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang.
claims.quote: APOLLON (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young. He was depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo was perhaps the most loved of the gods, worshipped at Delphi and Delos, among the most famous of Greek religious sanctuaries.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo mungkin dewa yang paling dicintai, dan dipuja di Delphi dan Delos, dua tempat suci agama Yunani yang paling terkenal.
claims.quote: Apollo was perhaps the most loved of all the gods. He was worshipped at Delphi and Delos, amongst the most famous of all Greek religious sanctuaries.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, one of the most famous myths of Apollo is the slaying of the serpent Python, which guarded the oracular shrine of Delphi.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu mitos paling terkenal Apollo menurut theoi.com adalah pembunuhan ular Python yang menjaga tempat suci orakel di Delphi.
claims.quote: The slaying of the serpent Python which guarded the oracular shrine of Delphoi (Delphi).

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo, son of Zeus and Leto and twin brother of Artemis, was born on the island of Delos.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo, putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, lahir di Pulau Delos.
claims.quote: Son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, Apollo was born on the island of Delos

claims.statement: At his first taste of ambrosia Apollo was said to have changed at once from babe to man; he was then given his bow, made by Hephaestus, master craftsman of Mount Olympus.
claims.statement_id: Pada kecapan pertama ambrosia, Apollo konon langsung berubah dari bayi menjadi pria dewasa; ia lalu diberi busur buatan Hephaestus, pengrajin ulung Gunung Olimpus.
claims.quote: At his first taste of ambrosia, he was said to have immediately transformed from babe to man. Apollo was then given his bow, made by the master craftsman of Mount Olympus, Hephaestus.

claims.statement: Apollo acquired his lyre from his half-brother Hermes, the messenger god, who as a baby had stolen Apollo's sacred cattle and reversed their hooves to make the tracks hard to follow.
claims.statement_id: Apollo memperoleh liranya dari saudara tirinya, Hermes sang dewa pembawa pesan, yang semasa bayi mencuri kawanan sapi suci Apollo dan membalik tapak kuku sapi-sapi itu agar jejaknya sulit diikuti.
claims.quote: Apollo acquired his lyre from his mischievous half-brother Hermes, the messenger god. While still a baby, Hermes had stolen Apollo's sacred herd of cattle, cleverly reversing their hooves to make it difficult to follow their tracks.

claims.statement: Hermes was allowed to keep his ill-gotten gains, but only after giving Apollo the lyre he had invented using a tortoiseshell.
claims.statement_id: Hermes boleh menyimpan hasil curiannya, tetapi hanya setelah menyerahkan kepada Apollo lira yang ia ciptakan dari cangkang kura-kura.
claims.quote: Hermes was permitted to keep his ill-gotten gains but only after he gave Apollo his lyre which he had invented using a tortoiseshell.

claims.statement: Among Apollo's most famous children are Orpheus, who inherited his father's musical skills on the lyre or kithara, and Asclepius, to whom he gave his knowledge of healing and medicine.
claims.statement_id: Di antara anak-anak Apollo yang paling terkenal adalah Orpheus, yang mewarisi keahlian musik ayahnya pada lira atau kithara, dan Asclepius, yang diberinya pengetahuan tentang penyembuhan dan pengobatan.
claims.quote: perhaps the most famous are Orpheus (who inherited his father's musical skills and became a virtuoso with the lyre or kithara), Asclepius (to whom he gave his knowledge of healing and medicine)

claims.statement: Apollo is a significant protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad; on the Trojan side, he repeatedly saved the lives of the Trojan heroes Hector, Aeneas and Glaukos by divine intervention.
claims.statement_id: Apollo adalah tokoh penting dalam kisah Perang Troya karya Homer, Iliad; ia berpihak kepada bangsa Troya dan beberapa kali menyelamatkan nyawa para pahlawan Troya Hector, Aeneas, dan Glaukos dengan campur tangan ilahinya.
claims.quote: Apollo is a significant protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad. On the side of the Trojans, he gives particular assistance to the Trojan heroes Hector, Aeneas, and Glaukos, saving their lives on more than one occasion with his divine intervention.

claims.statement: Apollo brought plague to the Achaeans, led the entire Trojan army in an attack that destroyed the defensive walls of the Greek camps, and guided Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles, killing the seemingly invincible Greek hero.
claims.statement_id: Apollo membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea, memimpin seluruh pasukan Troya menghancurkan tembok pertahanan kamp Yunani, dan menuntun panah Paris ke tumit Achilles sehingga pahlawan Yunani yang tampak kebal itu tewas.
claims.quote: He brought plague to the Achaeans, led the entire Trojan army (holding Zeus' fearsome aegis) in an attack which destroyed the defensive walls of the Greek camps, and was also responsible for guiding Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles, killing the seemingly invincible Greek hero.

claims.statement: Apollo and Zeus had a serious falling out when Zeus killed Asclepius for using his medicinal skills to bring a mortal back to life; in revenge Apollo killed the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants who made Zeus' thunderbolts.
claims.statement_id: Apollo dan Zeus sempat bertikai hebat ketika Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana dengan keahlian pengobatannya; sebagai balasan Apollo membunuh para Kiklops, raksasa bermata satu pembuat petir Zeus.
claims.quote: The pair did have a serious falling out when Zeus killed Asclepius after he had used his marvellous medicinal skills to bring a mortal back to life. In revenge, Apollo then killed the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants who made Zeus' thunderbolts.

claims.statement: As punishment, Apollo had to spend a year in the humble service of Admetus of Therae, tending the king's sheep.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai hukuman, Apollo harus mengabdi selama setahun kepada Admetus dari Therae dengan menggembalakan domba raja itu.
claims.quote: As punishment, Apollo was obliged to spend a year in the humble service of Admetus of Therae, tending the king's sheep.

claims.statement: Apollo's darker side as bringer of plague and divine retribution is seen most famously when, with his sister Artemis, he slew Niobe's six (or in some accounts seven) sons as punishment for her boast that she was more fertile than Leto.
claims.statement_id: Sisi gelap Apollo sebagai pembawa wabah dan pembalasan ilahi tampak paling terkenal ketika ia bersama saudarinya Artemis menewaskan enam (atau dalam sebagian riwayat tujuh) putra Niobe sebagai hukuman atas kesombongannya bahwa ia lebih subur daripada Leto.
claims.quote: Apollo's darker side as the bringer of plague and divine retribution is seen most famously when he is, with his sister Artemis, the remorseless slayer of Niobe's six (or in some accounts seven) sons as punishment for her boasting that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

claims.statement: Another victim of Apollo's wrath was the satyr Marsyas, who unwisely claimed to be more musically gifted than the god; the two competed and the Muses ruled that Apollo was the better musician.
claims.statement_id: Korban lain amarah Apollo adalah satir Marsyas yang dengan gegabah mengaku lebih berbakat dalam musik daripada sang dewa; keduanya bertanding dan para Muse memutuskan Apollo musisi yang lebih baik.
claims.quote: Another hapless victim of Apollo's wrath was the satyr Marsyas who unwisely claimed he was musically more gifted than the god. The pair had a competition and the Muses ruled that Apollo was indeed the better musician.

claims.statement: Apollo then had Marsyas flayed alive for his presumption and nailed his skin to a pine tree.
claims.statement_id: Apollo kemudian menguliti Marsyas hidup-hidup karena kelancangannya dan memaku kulitnya pada sebatang pohon pinus.
claims.quote: Apollo then had the mortal flayed alive for his presumption and nailed his skin to a pine tree.

claims.statement: According to legend, Apollo, wishing to reveal his father Zeus's intentions to humanity, created the oracle on the site where he had killed the serpent (or dragon) Python; the Pythian games were begun there to commemorate the death of this divine creature.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, Apollo yang hendak menyingkapkan kehendak ayahnya, Zeus, kepada manusia mendirikan orakel di tempat ia membunuh ular (atau naga) Python; Pythian Games dimulai di tempat itu untuk memperingati kematian makhluk ilahi tersebut.
claims.quote: According to legend, Apollo, wishing to reveal to humanity the intentions of his father Zeus, created the oracle on the site where he had killed the serpent (or dragon) Python. The Panhellenic Pythian games were begun at the site in order to commemorate the death of this divine creature.

claims.statement: The oracle of Delphi was already well visited in the 8th century BCE, despite being hard to reach and open only in summer.
claims.statement_id: Orakel Delphi sudah ramai dikunjungi pada abad ke-8 SM, meskipun sulit dijangkau dan hanya buka pada musim panas.
claims.quote: The oracle of Delphi was already well-visited in the 8th century BCE - despite being difficult to get to and open only in summer

claims.statement: Objects associated with Apollo include a silver bow, symbolic of his prowess as an archer, and a kithara (or lyre) made from a tortoise shell, symbolic of his musical ability and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.
claims.statement_id: Benda yang dikaitkan dengan Apollo antara lain busur perak, lambang kehebatannya memanah, dan kithara (lira) dari cangkang kura-kura, lambang kemampuan musiknya dan kepemimpinannya atas paduan suara sembilan Muse.
claims.quote: a silver bow - symbolic of his prowess as an archer. a kithara (or lyre) - made from the shell of a tortoise, this was symbolic of Apollo's ability in music and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

claims.statement: Apollo oversaw the initiation rites of young males (ephebes) as they entered the full civic community and became warriors.
claims.statement_id: Apollo mengawasi upacara inisiasi para pemuda (efebe) saat mereka memasuki masyarakat warga sepenuhnya dan menjadi prajurit.
claims.quote: Apollo oversaw the initiation rites performed by young males (ephebes) as they entered the full civic community and became warriors.

claims.statement: The god is often associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree the link between Apollo and Helios goes back no further than the 5th century BCE.
claims.statement_id: Sang dewa sering dikaitkan dengan matahari (sebagai Phoebus Apollo) dan dewa matahari Helios, tetapi para ahli modern umumnya sepakat bahwa kaitan Apollo dengan Helios tidak lebih tua daripada abad ke-5 SM.
claims.quote: The god is frequently associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree that the link between Apollo and Helios does not go further back than the 5th century BCE.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, the view almost universal among later poets, mythographers and philosophers was that Apollo was identical with Helios, the Sun.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, pandangan yang hampir universal di kalangan penyair, penulis mitologi, dan filsuf kemudian adalah bahwa Apollo identik dengan Helios, sang Matahari.
claims.quote: the view which was almost universal among the later poets, mythographers, and philesophers, and according to which Apollo was identical with Helios, or the Sun

claims.statement: According to Apollodorus, the oracle had earlier belonged to Themis and the dragon Python guarded the mysterious chasm; after slaying the monster, Apollo took possession of the oracle.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Apollodorus, orakel itu sebelumnya dimiliki Themis dan naga Python menjaga celah misteriusnya; setelah membunuh monster itu, Apollo mengambil alih orakel tersebut.
claims.quote: According to Apollodorus, the oracle had previously been in the possession of Themis, and the dragon Python guarded the mysterious chasm, and Apollo, after having slain the monster, took possession of the oracle.

claims.statement: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hyginus, Python sendirilah yang memiliki orakel itu.
claims.quote: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle

claims.statement: All sudden deaths, whether regarded as punishment or reward, were believed to result from Apollo's arrows, and with the same arrows he sent the plague into the Greek camp.
claims.statement_id: Semua kematian mendadak, baik dianggap hukuman maupun ganjaran, dipercaya akibat panah Apollo, dan dengan panah yang sama ia mengirim wabah ke kemah orang Yunani.
claims.quote: All sudden deaths of men, whether they were regarded as a punishment or a reward, were believed to be the effect of the arrows of Apollo; and with the same arrows he sent the plague into the camp of the Greeks.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Apollo and his worship, festivals and oracles had more influence upon the Greeks than any other god.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Apollo beserta pemujaan, festival, dan orakelnya lebih besar pengaruhnya atas orang Yunani daripada dewa lain mana pun.
claims.quote: Apollo and his worship, his festivals and oracles, had more influence upon the Greeks than any other god

claims.statement: The worship of Apollo at Rome is first heard of in the year 430 BC, when a temple was raised to him to avert a plague.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan Apollo di Roma pertama kali terdengar pada tahun 430 SM, ketika sebuah kuil didirikan untuk menolak wabah.
claims.quote: But the first time that we hear of the worship of Apollo at Rome is in the year B. C. 430, when, for the purpose of averting a plague, a temple was raised to him

claims.statement: The etymology of the name Apollo (Ἀπόλλων) is unclear; the Greeks most often associated it with the verb apollymi, "to destroy".
claims.statement_id: Asal kata nama Apollo (Ἀπόλλων) tidak jelas; orang Yunani paling sering mengaitkan nama itu dengan kata kerja apollymi, "menghancurkan".
claims.quote: The etymology of the name is unclear. The spelling Ἀπόλλων ... Thus, the Greeks most often associated Apollo's name with the Greek verb ἀπόλλυμι (apollymi), "to destroy".

claims.statement: According to Greek tradition he helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy, but this may reflect cultural influence in the reverse direction, since Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tradisi Yunani, Apollo membantu para pemukim Kreta atau Arkadia mendirikan kota Troya; namun kisah ini mungkin mencerminkan pengaruh budaya dari arah sebaliknya, karena teks paku Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas yang berkaitan dengan kota Wilusa.
claims.quote: According to Greek tradition, he helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy. However, this story may reflect a cultural influence which had the reverse direction: Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa

claims.statement: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow; others included the kithara, the plectrum and the sword, and another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.
claims.statement_id: Atribut Apollo yang paling umum adalah busur dan anak panah; atribut lainnya mencakup kithara, plektrum, dan pedang, dan lambang umum lain adalah trivet persembahan yang melambangkan kekuatan nubuatnya.
claims.quote: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow. Other attributes of his included the kithara (an advanced version of the common lyre), the plectrum and the sword. Another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

claims.statement: In literary contexts Apollo represents harmony, order and reason, contrasted with Dionysus, god of wine, who represents ecstasy and disorder.
claims.statement_id: Dalam konteks sastra, Apollo melambangkan keselarasan, keteraturan, dan nalar, yang dikontraskan dengan Dionysus, dewa anggur, yang melambangkan kegairahan dan kekacauan.
claims.quote: In literary contexts, Apollo represents harmony, order, and reason—characteristics contrasted with those of Dionysus, god of wine, who represents ecstasy and disorder.

claims.statement: The god's instruction of the Muses formed the subject of Igor Stravinsky's Apollon musagète (1927–1928).
claims.statement_id: Pengajaran sang dewa kepada para Muse menjadi pokok karya Igor Stravinsky, Apollon musagète (1927–1928).
claims.quote: the god's instruction of the Muses formed the subject of Igor Stravinsky's Apollon musagète (1927–1928)

claims.statement: The 1960s and 1970s NASA program for orbiting and landing astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo by NASA manager Abe Silverstein.
claims.statement_id: Program NASA tahun 1960-an dan 1970-an untuk mengorbitkan dan mendaratkan astronaut di Bulan dinamai menurut Apollo oleh manajer NASA Abe Silverstein.
claims.quote: In spaceflight, the 1960s and 1970s NASA program for orbiting and landing astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo, by NASA manager Abe Silverstein

claims.statement: Apollo appears often in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful beardless youth, and is easily identified by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer, and a bow and quiver.
claims.statement_id: Apollo sering muncul dalam semua media seni Yunani kuno, paling sering sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut, dan mudah dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu (penanda orakelnya di Delphi), rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah.
claims.quote: Apollo appears frequently in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful, beardless youth. He is easily identified with either a kithara or a lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer (which he often fights over with Hercules), and a bow and quiver.

claims.statement: Apollo was a much-loved god, most likely because of his association with many positive aspects of the human condition such as music, poetry, purification, healing and medicine.
claims.statement_id: Apollo adalah dewa yang sangat dicintai, kemungkinan besar karena kaitannya dengan banyak segi positif kehidupan manusia seperti musik, puisi, penyucian, penyembuhan, dan pengobatan.
claims.quote: Apollo was a much-loved god, and this was most likely due to his association with many positive aspects of the human condition such as music, poetry, purification, healing, and medicine.

images.description: Apollo of the Belvedere is a celebrated marble sculpture from Classical Antiquity. It was rediscovered at Anzio in the late 15th century (1489), during the Renaissance. From the mid-18th century, it was considered the greatest ancient sculpture and for centuries epitomized ideals of aesthetic perfection. The white marble sculpture, which is 2.24 m (7.3 feet) high, depicts the Greek god Apollo.

claims.statement: Athena or Athene, often called Pallas, is an ancient Greek goddess of wisdom, warfare and handicraft later syncretised with the Roman Minerva and Etruscan Menrva.
claims.statement_id: Athena atau Athene, sering bergelar Pallas, adalah dewi Yunani kuno kebijaksanaan, peperangan, dan kerajinan yang kemudian disamakan dengan dewi Romawi Minerva dan dewi Etruria Menrva.
claims.quote: Athena or Athene, often given the epithet Pallas, is an ancient Greek goddess associated with wisdom, warfare, and handicraft who was later syncretised with the Roman goddess Minerva and Etruscan Menrva.

claims.statement: Athena was patron of many Greek cities, especially Athens, source of her name; her symbols are owls, olive trees, snakes and the gorgoneion, and she is shown helmeted with a spear.
claims.statement_id: Athena dianggap pelindung berbagai kota Yunani, terutama Athena, asal namanya; lambangnya burung hantu, pohon zaitun, ular, dan gorgoneion, dan ia digambarkan berhelm dan memegang tombak.
claims.quote: Athena was regarded as the patron and protectress of various cities across Greece, particularly the city of Athens, from which she most likely received her name. Her major symbols include owls, olive trees, snakes, and the gorgoneion. In art, she is generally depicted wearing a helmet and holding a spear.

claims.statement: The Parthenon on the Athenian Acropolis is dedicated to her, along with numerous other temples and monuments.
claims.statement_id: Parthenon di Akropolis Athena dipersembahkan kepada Athena, bersama banyak kuil dan monumen lainnya.
claims.quote: The Parthenon on the Athenian Acropolis is dedicated to her, along with numerous other temples and monuments.

claims.statement: In Greek mythology Athena was born from the forehead of her father Zeus; in Hesiod's Theogony this happened after Zeus swallowed Metis while she was pregnant with Athena. In the founding myth of Athens, Athena bested Poseidon in a contest over patronage of the city by creating the first olive tree.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Yunani, Athena lahir dari dahi ayahnya, Zeus; menurut Theogony karya Hesiod, hal itu terjadi setelah Zeus menelan Metis yang sedang mengandungnya. Dalam mitos pendirian Athena, ia mengalahkan Poseidon dalam perebutan perlindungan kota dengan menciptakan pohon zaitun pertama.
claims.quote: In Greek mythology, Athena was born from the forehead of her father Zeus; in Hesiod's Theogony, this occurred after Zeus swallowed his consort Metis while she was pregnant with Athena. In the founding myth of Athens, Athena bested Poseidon in a competition over patronage of the city by creating the first olive tree.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Athena was the Olympian goddess of wisdom and good counsel, war, the defence of towns, heroic endeavour, weaving, pottery and various other crafts, depicted as a stately woman armed with shield and spear, in a long robe and crested helm, and wearing the aigis.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Athena adalah dewi Olimpus kebijaksanaan dan nasihat yang baik, perang, pertahanan kota, usaha kepahlawanan, menenun, tembikar, dan berbagai kerajinan lain; ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan agung bersenjata perisai dan tombak, berjubah panjang, berhelm berjambul, dan beraigis.
claims.quote: was the Olympian goddess of wisdom and good counsel, war, the defence of towns, heroic endeavour, weaving, pottery and various other crafts. She was depicted as a stately woman armed with a shield and spear, and wearing a long robe, crested helm, and the famed aigis

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, among Athena's famous myths is her assisting of Perseus in his quest to slay the Gorgon and of the Argonauts in their quest for the Golden Fleece.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, salah satu mitos terkenal Athena adalah bantuannya kepada Perseus dalam usahanya membunuh Gorgon dan kepada para Argonaut dalam pencarian Bulu Domba Emas.
claims.quote: The assisting of Perseus in his quest to slay the Gorgon and the Argonauts in their quest for the Golden Fleece.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Athena was Zeus's favourite daughter and perhaps the wisest, bravest and most resourceful Olympian.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Athena putri kesayangan Zeus dan mungkin dewa Olimpus yang paling bijak, paling berani, dan paling cerdik.
claims.quote: She was the favourite daughter of Zeus and was, perhaps, the wisest, most courageous, and certainly the most resourceful of the Olympian gods.

claims.statement: In Attic Greek her name is Ἀθηνᾶ (Athēnâ) or Ἀθηναία (Athēnaía).
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Yunani Attika namanya Ἀθηνᾶ (Athēnâ) atau Ἀθηναία (Athēnaía).
claims.quote: Attic Greek: Ἀθηνᾶ , Athēnâ , or Ἀθηναία , Athēnaía

claims.statement: She was known as Polias and Poliouchos (both from polis, "city-state"), and her temples were usually located atop the fortified acropolis in the centre of the city.
claims.statement_id: Athena dikenal sebagai Polias dan Poliouchos (keduanya dari polis, "negara-kota"), dan kuil-kuilnya biasanya terletak di atas akropolis berbenteng di pusat kota.
claims.quote: She was known as Polias and Poliouchos (both derived from polis, meaning "city-state"), and her temples were usually located atop the fortified acropolis in the central part of the city.

claims.statement: As patron of craft and weaving Athena was known as Ergane; she was also a warrior goddess, believed to lead soldiers into battle as Athena Promachos.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai pelindung kerajinan dan tenun, Athena dikenal sebagai Ergane; ia juga dewi pejuang yang dipercaya memimpin prajurit ke medan perang sebagai Athena Promachos.
claims.quote: As the patron of craft and weaving, Athena was known as Ergane. She was also a warrior goddess, and was believed to lead soldiers into battle as Athena Promachos.

claims.statement: Her main festival in Athens was the Panathenaia, celebrated in the month of Hekatombaion in midsummer and the most important festival of the Athenian calendar.
claims.statement_id: Festival utamanya di Athena adalah Panathenaia, yang dirayakan pada bulan Hekatombaion di tengah musim panas dan merupakan festival terpenting dalam kalender Athena.
claims.quote: Her main festival in Athens was the Panathenaia, which was celebrated during the month of Hekatombaion in midsummer and was the most important festival on the Athenian calendar.

claims.statement: In ancient times scholars argued whether Athena was named after Athens or Athens after Athena; now scholars generally agree that the goddess takes her name from the city.
claims.statement_id: Pada zaman kuno para ahli berdebat apakah Athena dinamai menurut kota Athena atau sebaliknya; kini para ahli umumnya sepakat bahwa sang dewi mengambil namanya dari kota itu.
claims.quote: In ancient times, scholars argued whether Athena was named after Athens or Athens after Athena. Now scholars generally agree that the goddess takes her name from the city

claims.statement: The name of the city in ancient Greek is Ἀθῆναι (Athȇnai), a plural toponym designating the place where, according to myth, she presided over the Athenai, a sisterhood devoted to her worship.
claims.statement_id: Nama kota itu dalam bahasa Yunani kuno adalah Ἀθῆναι (Athȇnai), toponim bentuk jamak, yang menunjuk tempat yang menurut mitos dipimpin Athena atas Athenai, persaudarian pemujanya.
claims.quote: The name of the city in ancient Greek is Ἀθῆναι (Athȇnai ), a plural toponym, designating the place where—according to myth—she presided over the Athenai, a sisterhood devoted to her worship.

claims.statement: In her aspect as a warrior maiden Athena was known as Parthenos (Παρθένος, "virgin"), because like the goddesses Artemis and Hestia she was believed to remain a virgin forever.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujudnya sebagai gadis pejuang, Athena dikenal sebagai Parthenos (Παρθένος, "perawan"), karena seperti dewi Artemis dan Hestia ia dipercaya tetap perawan selamanya.
claims.quote: In her aspect as a warrior maiden, Athena was known as Parthenos (Παρθένος "virgin"), because, like her fellow goddesses Artemis and Hestia, she was believed to remain perpetually a virgin.

claims.statement: In the later writings of the Roman poet Ovid, Athena was said to have competed against the mortal Arachne in weaving and then turned her into the first spider, and to have transformed Medusa into the Gorgon after witnessing the young woman being raped by Poseidon in the goddess's temple.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tulisan penyair Romawi Ovidius yang lebih kemudian, Athena disebut bertanding menenun melawan Arachne yang fana lalu mengubahnya menjadi laba-laba pertama, dan mengubah Medusa menjadi Gorgon setelah menyaksikan perempuan muda itu diperkosa Poseidon di kuil sang dewi.
claims.quote: In the later writings of the Roman poet Ovid, Athena was said to have competed against the mortal Arachne in a weaving competition, afterward transforming Arachne into the first spider, and to have transformed Medusa into the Gorgon after witnessing the young woman being raped by Poseidon in the goddess's temple.

claims.statement: Athena lent Perseus her polished bronze shield so he could view Medusa's reflection without being petrified; Hermes lent Perseus his harpe to behead Medusa.
claims.statement_id: Athena meminjamkan Perseus perisai perunggu mengilapnya agar ia dapat melihat bayangan Medusa tanpa menjadi batu; Hermes meminjamkan harpe untuk memenggal Medusa.
claims.quote: Athena lent Perseus her polished bronze shield to view Medusa's reflection without becoming petrified himself. Hermes lent Perseus his harpe to behead Medusa with.

claims.statement: In other traditions Athena's father is sometimes listed as Pallas, Brontes or Itonos, and Poseidon is also sometimes listed as her father, by the nymph Tritonis.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi lain, ayah Athena kadang disebut Pallas, Brontes, atau Itonos, dan Poseidon juga kadang disebut sebagai ayahnya, dari nimfa Tritonis.
claims.quote: In other traditions, Athena's father is sometimes listed as Pallas, Brontes, or Itonos. Poseidon is also sometimes listed as her father, by the nymph Tritonis.

claims.statement: A full-scale replica of the Parthenon has stood for over a century in Nashville, Tennessee; in 1990 the curators added a gilded forty-two-foot replica of Phidias's Athena Parthenos, made of concrete and fiberglass.
claims.statement_id: Replika Parthenon berukuran penuh telah berdiri lebih dari seabad di Nashville, Tennessee; pada 1990 para kurator menambahkan replika Athena Parthenos karya Phidias setinggi empat puluh dua kaki yang disepuh emas, terbuat dari beton dan serat kaca.
claims.quote: For over a century, a full-scale replica of the Parthenon has stood in Nashville, Tennessee. In 1990, the curators added a gilded forty-two-foot (12.5 m) tall replica of Phidias's Athena Parthenos, built from concrete and fiberglass.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Athena contested with Poseidon for dominion of Athens, producing the first olive tree while he produced the first horse.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Athena bersaing dengan Poseidon memperebutkan kekuasaan atas Athena; ia menghasilkan pohon zaitun pertama dan Poseidon kuda pertama.
claims.quote: Her contest with Poseidon for dominion of Athens in which she produced the first olive tree and he the first horse.

claims.statement: In the War of the Giants, according to theoi.com, she buried Enceladus beneath Mount Etna and made her aigis from the skin of Pallas.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Perang Para Raksasa, menurut theoi.com, Athena mengubur Enceladus di bawah Gunung Etna dan membuat aigisnya dari kulit Pallas.
claims.quote: The War of the Giants in which she buried Enkelados (Enceladus) beneath Mount Etna and made her aigis from the skin of Pallas.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Athena held a weaving contest with Arachne, who was transformed by the goddess into a spider.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Athena bertanding menenun dengan Arachne, yang diubah sang dewi menjadi laba-laba.
claims.quote: The weaving contest with Arakhne (Arachne) who was transformed by the goddess into a spider

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Athena blinded Teiresias for seeing her naked while bathing.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Athena membutakan Teiresias karena melihatnya telanjang saat mandi.
claims.quote: The blinding of Teiresias (Tiresias) for seeing her naked while bathing.

claims.statement: In the Judgement of Paris, according to theoi.com, she competed with Hera and Aphrodite for the prize of the golden apple.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Penghakiman Paris, menurut theoi.com, Athena bersaing dengan Hera dan Aphrodite memperebutkan hadiah apel emas.
claims.quote: The Judgement of Paris in which she competed with Hera and Aphrodite for the prize of the golden apple.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Athena assisted Heracles with his twelve labours.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Athena membantu Herakles dalam kedua belas pekerjaannya.
claims.quote: The assisting of Herakles (Heracles) with his twelve labours.

claims.statement: In the Trojan War, according to theoi.com, she sided with the Greeks but attacked their ships with a storm when they failed to punish Oilean Aias (Ajax) for violating her Trojan shrine.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Perang Troya, menurut theoi.com, Athena berpihak kepada bangsa Yunani, tetapi menyerang kapal-kapal mereka dengan badai ketika mereka tidak menghukum Aias dari Lokris yang melanggar kuilnya di Troya.
claims.quote: The Trojan War where she sided with the Greeks in battle, but attacked their ships with a storm when they failed to punish Oilean Aias (Ajax) for violating her Trojan shrine.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Athena's aigis is a snake-trimmed cape adorned with the monstrous visage of the Gorgon Medousa (Medusa).
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, aigis Athena adalah jubah berhias ular yang dihiasi wajah mengerikan Gorgon Medousa (Medusa).
claims.quote: the famed aigis--a snake-trimmed cape adorned with the monstrous visage of the Gorgon Medousa (Medusa)

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, as set out in the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, Metis, Zeus's first wife, was Athena's mother, but when she was pregnant Zeus, on the advice of Gaea and Uranus, swallowed Metis and afterwards gave birth to Athena himself, who sprang from his head.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, seperti diuraikan Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, Metis istri pertama Zeus adalah ibu Athena, tetapi ketika Metis mengandungnya, Zeus atas nasihat Gaea dan Uranus menelan Metis, lalu sendiri melahirkan Athena yang melompat keluar dari kepalanya.
claims.quote: Metis, the first wife of Zeus, was the mother of Athena, but when Metis was pregnant with her, Zeus, on the advice of Gaea and Uranus, swallowed Metis up, and afterwards gave birth himself to Athena, who sprang from his head.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, Homer calls her a daughter of Zeus without any allusion to her mother or to the manner in which she came into existence.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, Homer menyebut Athena putri Zeus tanpa menyinggung ibunya atau cara ia diadakan.
claims.quote: calls her a daughter of Zeus, without any allusion to her mother or to the manner in which she was called into existence

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, a second set of traditions regard her as the daughter of Pallas, the winged giant, whom she afterwards killed for attempting to violate her chastity, using his skin as her aegis.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, satu kelompok tradisi menyebut Athena putri Pallas, raksasa bersayap, yang kemudian ia bunuh karena mencoba melanggar kesuciannya dan kulitnya ia pakai sebagai aigis.
claims.quote: a second set regard her as the daughter of Pallas, the winged giant, whom she afterwards killed on account of his attempting to violate her chastity, whose skin she used as her aegis

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, a third tradition takes us to Libya and calls Athena a daughter of Poseidon and Tritonis.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, tradisi ketiga membawa kita ke Libya dan menyebut Athena putri Poseidon dan Tritonis.
claims.quote: A third tradition carries us to Libya, and calls Athena a daughter of Poseidon and Tritonis.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, her power and wisdom appear in her being the protectress and preserver of the state and of social institutions.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, kekuatan dan kebijaksanaan Athena tampak pada perannya sebagai pelindung dan penjaga negara serta lembaga-lembaga sosial.
claims.quote: her power and wisdom appear in her being the protectress and preserver of the state and of social institutions.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, Athena was a goddess in whom power and wisdom were harmoniously blended.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, Athena adalah dewi yang di dalam dirinya kekuatan dan kebijaksanaan berpadu selaras.
claims.quote: a goddess in whom power and wisdom were harmoniously blended

claims.statement: As protectress of agriculture Athena is represented as the inventor of the plough and rake: she created the olive tree, the greatest blessing of Attica, and taught people to yoke oxen to the plough.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai pelindung pertanian, Athena digambarkan sebagai penemu bajak dan garu: ia menciptakan pohon zaitun, berkah terbesar Attika, dan mengajari orang memasang lembu pada bajak.
claims.quote: As the protectress of agriculture, Athena is represented as the inventor of the plough and rake: she created the olive tree, the greatest blessing of Attica, taught the people to yoke oxen to the plough

claims.statement: She was believed to have instituted the ancient court of the Areiopagus.
claims.statement_id: Athena dipercaya telah mendirikan pengadilan kuno Areiopagus.
claims.quote: She was believed to have instituted the ancient court of the Areiopagus

claims.statement: Athena is a major protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad, where she supports the Achaeans and their heroes, especially Achilles, Menelaos (saved from Pandaros's arrow) and Diomedes, whose spear is once diverted to wound Ares himself.
claims.statement_id: Athena adalah tokoh utama dalam kisah Perang Troya karya Homer, Iliad, tempat ia mendukung bangsa Achaea dan para pahlawannya, terutama Achilles, Menelaos yang diselamatkan dari panah Pandaros, dan Diomedes yang tombaknya sekali dibelokkan hingga melukai Ares sendiri.
claims.quote: Athena was a major protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad where she supports the Achaeans and their heroes, especially Achilles, to whom she gives encouragement and wise counsel, Menelaos, who is saved from the arrow of Pandaros, and Diomedes, whose spear, in one notable episode, is diverted to injure Ares himself.

claims.statement: She also protected Odysseus and is credited with giving him the idea of the Wooden Horse.
claims.statement_id: Athena juga melindungi Odysseus dan dianggap memberinya gagasan Kuda Kayu.
claims.quote: She also gave protection to Odysseus and is credited with giving him the idea of the Wooden Horse.

claims.statement: Objects associated with the goddess include an owl, symbol of wisdom, and the olive tree; in art she is often shown with armour, a golden helmet, a shield and a spear.
claims.statement_id: Benda yang dikaitkan dengan Athena mencakup burung hantu, lambang kebijaksanaan, dan pohon zaitun; dalam seni ia sering digambarkan berzirah, berhelm emas, berperisai, dan memegang tombak.
claims.quote: Objects associated with the goddess include an owl - symbol of wisdom - and the olive tree. She is often depicted in art with armour, a golden helmet, a shield, and holding a spear.

claims.statement: Her armour is the aegis, made in some accounts from the skin of a Giant, hung with golden tassels and featuring the head of the Gorgon given to her by Perseus.
claims.statement_id: Zirah Athena adalah aigis yang menurut sebagian riwayat dibuat dari kulit seorang Raksasa, berumbai emas, dan bergambar kepala Gorgon yang diberikan Perseus kepadanya.
claims.quote: Her armour is the aegis made, in some accounts, from the skin of a Giant, hung with tassels of gold, and featuring the head of the Gorgon given to her by Perseus.

claims.statement: The most famous representation of Athena in the ancient world was undoubtedly the monumental gold and ivory statue by Pheidias that stood in the Parthenon of Athens and was over 12 m high.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran Athena yang paling terkenal di dunia kuno tak diragukan lagi adalah arca raksasa dari emas dan gading karya Pheidias yang berada di Parthenon di Athena dan tingginya lebih dari 12 m.
claims.quote: The most famous representation of Athena in the ancient world was undoubtedly the monumental gold and ivory statue of the goddess by Pheidias which resided in the Parthenon of Athens and was over 12 m high.

claims.statement: Both Homer and Hesiod refer to Athena as "bright-eyed" and "Tritogeneia".
claims.statement_id: Baik Homer maupun Hesiod menyebut Athena "bermata cerah" dan "Tritogeneia".
claims.quote: Both Homer and Hesiod refer to Athena as 'bright-eyed' and 'Tritogeneia'.

issues.message: Keterkaitan otomatis: nama berkas, kategori "Brahma", dipakai di ne.wikipedia.org: ब्रह्मा. Cek visual tetap diperlukan.

claims.statement: Brahma (ब्रह्मा) is a Hindu god called the Creator in the Trimurti with Vishnu and Shiva, associated with creation, knowledge and the Vedas; some Puranas say he created himself in the golden embryo Hiranyagarbha.
claims.statement_id: Brahma (ब्रह्मा) adalah dewa Hindu yang disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti bersama Wisnu dan Siwa, dikaitkan dengan penciptaan, pengetahuan, dan Weda; menurut beberapa Purana ia menciptakan dirinya dalam janin emas Hiranyagarbha.
claims.quote: is a Hindu god, referred to as "the Creator" within the Trimurti, the trinity of supreme divinity that includes Vishnu and Shiva. He is associated with creation of everything, knowledge, and the Vedas. Brahma is prominently mentioned in creation legends. In some Puranas, he created himself in a golden embryo known as the Hiranyagarbha.

claims.statement: Brahma is often identified with the Vedic god Prajapati; in the post-Vedic period he was a prominent deity and his sect existed, but by the 7th century he had lost his significance.
claims.statement_id: Brahma sering disamakan dengan dewa Weda Prajapati; pada masa pasca-Weda ia dewa terkemuka dan sektenya ada, tetapi menjelang abad ke-7 ia kehilangan kepentingannya.
claims.quote: Brahma is frequently identified with the Vedic god Prajapati. During the post-Vedic period, Brahma was a prominent deity and his sect existed; however, by the 7th century, he had lost his significance.

claims.statement: Brahma is shown as a bearded red or golden man with four heads and hands; the heads represent the four Vedas and face the four directions; he sits on a lotus and rides a hamsa.
claims.statement_id: Brahma digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berjanggut berkulit merah atau keemasan dengan empat kepala dan tangan; kepalanya melambangkan empat Weda dan menghadap empat arah; ia duduk di atas teratai dan kendaraannya hamsa.
claims.quote: Brahma is commonly depicted as a red or golden-complexioned bearded man with four heads and hands. His four heads represent the four Vedas and are pointed to the four cardinal directions. He is seated on a lotus and his vahana (mount) is a hamsa

claims.statement: Few temples dedicated to him exist in India, the most famous being the Brahma Temple at Pushkar in Rajasthan.
claims.statement_id: Hanya sedikit kuil yang dipersembahkan kepadanya di India, yang paling terkenal adalah Kuil Brahma di Pushkar, Rajasthan.
claims.quote: Few temples dedicated to him exist in India, the most famous being the Brahma Temple, Pushkar in Rajasthan.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is still honoured with an annual ceremony at Pushkar, Rajasthan, India, and remains popular in Southeast Asia, especially Thailand and Bali.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma masih dihormati dengan upacara tahunan di Pushkar, Rajasthan, India, dan tetap populer di Asia Tenggara, terutama di Thailand dan Bali.
claims.quote: He is still honoured today with an annual ceremony at the pilgrimage site of Pushkar in Rajasthan, India and he remains a popular figure in Southeast Asia, especially in Thailand and Bali.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and created good and evil, light and dark, and four kinds: gods, demons, ancestors and men.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma muncul dari telur emas kosmis lalu menciptakan baik dan buruk, terang dan gelap, serta empat golongan: dewa, raksasa, leluhur, dan manusia.
claims.quote: In the beginning, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and he then created good & evil and light & dark from his own person. He also created the four types: gods, demons, ancestors, and men (the first being Manu).

claims.statement: He was also overshadowed by other major deities such as Vishnu, Shiva and Mahadevi and demoted to the role of a secondary creator, created by the major deities.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga dibayangi dewa-dewa utama lain seperti Wisnu, Siwa, dan Mahadewi dan diturunkan menjadi pencipta sekunder yang diciptakan oleh dewa-dewa utama.
claims.quote: He was also overshadowed by other major deities like Vishnu, Shiva, and Mahadevi and demoted to the role of a secondary creator, who was created by the major deities.

claims.statement: Historians believe that the major reasons for Brahma's downfall were the rise of Shaivism and Vaishnavism, their replacement of him with Mahadevi in the Smarta tradition, and frequent attacks by Buddhists, Jains and Hindus who worship Shiva and Vishnu.
claims.statement_id: Para sejarawan berpendapat bahwa alasan utama kemerosotan Brahma adalah bangkitnya Saiwa dan Waisnawa, penggantian dirinya oleh Mahadewi dalam tradisi Smarta, dan serangan terus-menerus dari umat Buddha, Jain, dan penganut Hindu pemuja Siwa dan Wisnu.
claims.quote: Historians believe that some of the major reasons for Brahma's downfall were the rise of Shaivism and Vaishnavism, their replacement of him with Mahadevi in the Smarta tradition, and the frequent attacks by Buddhists, Jains, Hindus who worship Shiva and Vishnu.

claims.statement: One of the earliest mentions of Brahma together with Vishnu and Shiva is in the fifth Prapathaka (lesson) of the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around the late 1st millennium BCE.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu penyebutan paling awal Brahma bersama Wisnu dan Siwa terdapat pada Prapathaka kelima Upanishad Maitrayaniya, yang kemungkinan disusun sekitar akhir milenium pertama SM.
claims.quote: One of the earliest mentions of Brahma with Vishnu and Shiva is in the fifth Prapathaka (lesson) of the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around the late 1st millennium BCE.

claims.statement: While the Maitrayaniya Upanishad maps Brahma to one of the elements of the guna theory, the text does not depict him as one of the trifunctional elements of the Trimurti idea found in later Puranic literature.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun Upanishad Maitrayaniya memetakan Brahma pada salah satu unsur teori guna, teks itu tidak menggambarkannya sebagai salah satu unsur trifungsi gagasan Trimurti yang terdapat dalam sastra Purana yang lebih kemudian.
claims.quote: While the Maitrayaniya Upanishad maps Brahma with one of the elements of the guṇas theory of Hinduism, the text does not depict him as one of the trifunctional elements of the Hindu Trimurti idea found in later Puranic literature.

claims.statement: Early texts such as the Brahmanda Purana say there was nothing but an eternal ocean, from which a golden egg called Hiranyagarbha emerged; the egg broke open and Brahma, who had created himself within it, came into existence (gaining the name Svayambhu), and then created the universe, the earth and other things.
claims.statement_id: Teks awal seperti Brahmanda Purana menyebut bahwa semula hanya ada samudra abadi; dari situ muncul telur emas bernama Hiranyagarbha. Telur itu pecah dan Brahma, yang telah menciptakan dirinya di dalamnya, lahir (dengan nama Svayambhu); lalu ia menciptakan alam semesta, bumi, dan hal-hal lain.
claims.quote: Early texts like the Brahmanda Purana describe that there was nothing but an eternal ocean. From this, a golden egg called Hiranyagarbha, emerged. The egg broke open and Brahma, who had created himself within it, came into existence (gaining the name Svayambhu). Then, he created the universe, the earth, and other things.

claims.statement: Vishnu-focused Puranas describe Brahma as born from a lotus emerging from the navel of Vishnu, and Shiva as born from a fire emerging from Vishnu's forehead.
claims.statement_id: Purana yang berpusat pada Wisnu menyebut bahwa Brahma lahir dari teratai yang muncul dari pusar Wisnu, dan Siwa lahir dari api yang muncul dari dahi Wisnu.
claims.quote: Vishnu-focused Puranas describe that Brahma was born from a lotus emerging from the navel of the god Vishnu and Shiva was born from a fire emerging from the forehead of the god Vishnu.

claims.statement: In contrast, Shiva-focused Puranas describe Brahma and Vishnu as born from the right and left sides of Shiva's waist.
claims.statement_id: Sebaliknya, Purana yang berpusat pada Siwa menyebut Brahma dan Wisnu lahir dari sisi kanan dan kiri pinggang Siwa.
claims.quote: In contrast, the Shiva-focused Puranas describe Brahma and Vishnu to be born from Shiva's right and left sides of his waist

claims.statement: Yet other texts describe the Tridevi as having created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, and state that Brahma is a secondary creator of the world working on their behalf.
claims.statement_id: Sumber lain menyebut bahwa Tridewi menciptakan Brahma, Wisnu, dan Siwa, dan teks-teks itu menyatakan Brahma pencipta sekunder dunia yang bekerja atas nama mereka.
claims.quote: Yet others describe that the Tridevi created Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, and these texts then state that Brahma is a secondary creator of the world working respectively on their behalf.

claims.statement: Brahma creates all the forms in the universe but not the primordial universe itself; in most Puranic texts his creative activity depends on the presence and power of a higher god or goddess.
claims.statement_id: Brahma menciptakan segala bentuk di alam semesta, tetapi bukan alam semesta primordial itu sendiri; dalam kebanyakan teks Purana, kegiatan penciptaannya bergantung pada kehadiran dan kekuatan dewa atau dewi yang lebih tinggi.
claims.quote: Brahma creates all the forms in the universe, but not the primordial universe itself. Thus in most Puranic texts, Brahma's creative activity depends on the presence and power of a higher god or higher goddess.

claims.statement: In post-Vedic Puranic literature Brahma creates but neither preserves nor destroys anything.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sastra Purana pasca-Weda, Brahma menciptakan tetapi tidak memelihara maupun menghancurkan apa pun.
claims.quote: In the post-Vedic Puranic literature, Brahma creates but neither preserves nor destroys anything.

claims.statement: The Puranas describe Brahma as the god creating time.
claims.statement_id: Purana menggambarkan Brahma sebagai dewa yang menciptakan waktu.
claims.quote: The Puranas describe Brahma as the god creating time.

claims.statement: Despite being believed to be the creator, Brahma is considered mortal according to scriptures. The Age of Brahma spans vast epochs in Hindu cosmology, and a kalpa is a day of Brahma.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun diyakini sebagai pencipta, Brahma dianggap fana menurut kitab suci. Usia Brahma menurut kosmologi Hindu mencakup kurun waktu yang sangat panjang, dan satu kalpa adalah satu hari Brahma.
claims.quote: Brahma, despite being believed to be the creator, is considered mortal according to scriptures. The Age of Brahma, according to Hindu cosmology, spans vast epochs of time. A kalpa is a day of Brahmā

claims.statement: Brahma is traditionally depicted with four faces and four arms; each face points to a cardinal direction, and his hands hold no weapons but symbols of knowledge and creation.
claims.statement_id: Brahma secara tradisional digambarkan berwajah empat dan berlengan empat; setiap wajahnya menghadap satu arah mata angin, dan tangannya tidak memegang senjata melainkan lambang pengetahuan dan penciptaan.
claims.quote: Brahma is traditionally depicted with four faces and four arms. Each face of his points to a cardinal direction. His hands hold no weapons, rather symbols of knowledge and creation.

claims.statement: Chapter 51 of the Manasara, an ancient Sanskrit design manual for making murtis and temples, states that a Brahma statue should be gold in colour.
claims.statement_id: Bab 51 Manasara, buku panduan desain kuno berbahasa Sanskerta untuk membuat murti dan kuil, menyatakan bahwa arca Brahma hendaknya berwarna emas.
claims.quote: Chapter 51 of the Manasara, an ancient design manual in Sanskrit for making murtis and temples, states that a Brahma statue should be gold in color.

claims.statement: Brahma's wife is the goddess Sarasvati, the embodiment of his power, the instrument of creation and the energy that drives his actions.
claims.statement_id: Istri Brahma adalah dewi Sarasvati, perwujudan kekuatannya, sarana penciptaan, dan tenaga yang menggerakkan tindakannya.
claims.quote: Brahma's wife is the goddess Sarasvati. She is the embodiment of his power, the instrument of creation and the energy that drives his actions.

claims.statement: Legends tell that Savitri, Brahma's wife, pronounced a curse restricting his worship to Pushkara.
claims.statement_id: Legenda menyebut bahwa Savitri, istri Brahma, mengucapkan kutukan yang membatasi pemujaan Brahma hanya di Pushkara.
claims.quote: Legends tell that Savitri, Brahma's wife, pronounced a curse restricting his worship to Pushkara.

claims.statement: In the account drawn from the Shiva Purana, Shiva then took his true form and cut off one of Brahma's five heads for his dishonesty, proclaiming that Brahma would no longer receive an active following and would have a low status of popularity.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisah dari Siwa Purana, Siwa lalu menampakkan wujud aslinya dan memenggal satu dari lima kepala Brahma karena ketidakjujurannya, serta menyatakan bahwa Brahma tidak akan lagi memiliki pengikut aktif dan akan berkedudukan rendah dalam kepopuleran.
claims.quote: Shiva then took his true form and cut off one of Brahma's five heads for his dishonesty, proclaiming that he would no longer receive an active following to his worship and would get a low status of popularity.

claims.statement: In that account Vishnu assumed the form of a boar, Varaha, and journeyed towards the earth, while Brahma assumed the form of a swan, Hamsa, and journeyed towards the sky.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah itu Wisnu menjelma babi hutan Waraha menuju bumi, sedangkan Brahma menjelma angsa Hamsa menuju langit.
claims.quote: Vishnu assumed the form of a boar as Varaha and journeyed towards the earth and Brahma assumed the form of a swan as Hamsa and journeyed towards the sky.

claims.statement: A statue of Brahma stands at the Erawan Shrine in Bangkok, Thailand, and is still revered today; the golden dome of the Government House of Thailand houses a statue of Phra Phrom, the Thai representation of Brahma.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah arca Brahma terdapat di Kuil Erawan di Bangkok, Thailand, dan masih dihormati hingga kini; kubah emas Gedung Pemerintah Thailand memuat arca Phra Phrom, wujud Brahma dalam budaya Thai.
claims.quote: A statue of Brahma is present at the Erawan Shrine in Bangkok, Thailand and continues to be revered in modern times. The golden dome of the Government House of Thailand houses a statue of Phra Phrom (Thai representation of Brahma).

claims.statement: One of the three largest temples in the 9th-century CE Prambanan complex in Yogyakarta, central Java (Indonesia), is dedicated to Brahma, the other two to Shiva (the largest) and Vishnu.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu dari tiga candi terbesar di kompleks Candi Prambanan abad ke-9 M di Yogyakarta, Jawa Tengah (Indonesia), dipersembahkan kepada Brahma; dua lainnya untuk Siwa (yang terbesar) dan Wisnu.
claims.quote: One of the three largest temples in the 9th-century CE Prambanan temples complex in Yogyakarta, central Java (Indonesia) is dedicated to Brahma, the other two to Shiva (largest of three) and Vishnu respectively.

claims.statement: A shrine of Brahma can be found in Cambodia's Angkor Wat.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah kuil Brahma terdapat di Angkor Wat, Kamboja.
claims.quote: A shrine of Brahma can be found in Cambodia's Angkor Wat.

claims.statement: The name of the country Burma is derived from Brahma; in medieval texts it is referred to as Brahma-desa.
claims.statement_id: Nama negara Burma diturunkan dari Brahma; dalam teks abad pertengahan negeri itu disebut Brahma-desa.
claims.quote: The name of the country Burma is derived from Brahma. In medieval texts, it is referred to as Brahma-desa.

claims.statement: According to the scriptures, Brahma created his children from his mind, and so they are called Manasaputra.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kitab suci, Brahma menciptakan anak-anaknya dari pikirannya sehingga mereka disebut Manasaputra.
claims.quote: According to the scriptures, Brahma created his children from his mind and thus, they are referred to as Manasaputra.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is the Hindu creator god, also known as the Grandfather and as a later equivalent of Prajapati, the primeval first god; in early Hindu sources such as the Mahabharata he is supreme in the triad of great Hindu gods that includes Shiva and Vishnu.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma adalah dewa pencipta Hindu, juga dikenal sebagai Kakek dan sebagai padanan kemudian Prajapati, dewa pertama yang purba; dalam sumber Hindu awal seperti Mahabharata ia tertinggi dalam triad dewa besar Hindu bersama Siwa dan Wisnu.
claims.quote: Brahma is the Hindu creator god. He is also known as the Grandfather and as a later equivalent of Prajapati, the primeval first god. In early Hindu sources such as the Mahabharata, Brahma is supreme in the triad of great Hindu gods which includes Shiva and Vishnu.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in later Puranas Brahma is no longer worshipped and other gods are assigned his myths, even though he always keeps his status as the creator god.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Purana yang lebih kemudian, menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma tidak lagi dipuja dan mitos-mitosnya diberikan kepada dewa lain, meskipun ia selalu tetap berstatus dewa pencipta.
claims.quote: In later Puranas (Hindu epics) Brahma is no longer worshipped and other gods are assigned his myths, even if he always maintains his status as the creator god.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma's epithet is ekahamsa, "the One Swan", and his vahanam (vehicle) is a peacock, swan or goose.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, julukan Brahma adalah ekahamsa, "Angsa Tunggal", dan wahananya adalah merak, angsa, atau angsa liar.
claims.quote: Brahma's epithet is ekahamsa, the One Swan. His vahanam ('vehicle') is a peacock, swan or goose.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in creating, the demons were born from Brahma's thigh and he abandoned his body, which became Night; after creating the good gods he abandoned his body again, which became Day, so demons gain the ascendancy at night and the gods, forces of goodness, rule the day.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam proses mencipta para iblis lahir dari paha Brahma sehingga ia meninggalkan tubuhnya yang lalu menjadi Malam; setelah menciptakan dewa-dewa yang baik ia meninggalkan tubuhnya lagi, yang lalu menjadi Siang, sehingga iblis unggul pada malam hari dan para dewa, kekuatan kebaikan, berkuasa pada siang hari.
claims.quote: In the process of creating, perhaps in a moment of distraction, the demons were born from Brahma's thigh and so he abandoned his own body which then became Night. After Brahma created good gods he abandoned his body once again, which then became Day, hence demons gain the ascendancy at night and gods, the forces of goodness, rule the day.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma then appointed Shiva to rule over humanity, although in later myths Brahma becomes a servant of Shiva.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma kemudian menunjuk Siwa untuk memerintah umat manusia, meskipun dalam mitos yang lebih kemudian Brahma menjadi pelayan Siwa.
claims.quote: Brahma then appointed Shiva to rule over humanity although in later myths Brahma becomes a servant of Shiva.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma had several wives, the most important being his daughter Sarasvati, who after the Creation bore Brahma the four Vedas (holy books of Hinduism) and all branches of knowledge.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma memiliki beberapa istri, yang terpenting putrinya Sarasvati, yang setelah Penciptaan melahirkan bagi Brahma keempat Weda (kitab suci Hindu) dan semua cabang pengetahuan.
claims.quote: Brahma had several wives, the most important being his daughter Sarasvati who, after the Creation, bore Brahma the four Vedas (holy books of Hinduism), all branches of knowledge

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, besides Daksa Brahma had other notable sons including the Seven Sages (Daksa being one) and the four famous Prajapatis: Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu and Narada, the latter the messenger between gods and men.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, selain Daksa, Brahma memiliki putra terkemuka lain, termasuk Tujuh Resi (salah satunya Daksa) dan empat Prajapati termasyhur: Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu, dan Narada, yang terakhir adalah pembawa pesan antara dewa dan manusia.
claims.quote: Besides Daksa, Brahma had other notable sons including the Seven Sages (of whom Daksa was one), and the four famous Prajapatis (deities): Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu, and Narada, the latter being the messenger between gods and men.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in another myth Brahma's first female is also Death, the evil force that brings balance to the universe and ensures it does not become over-crowded.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam mitos lain perempuan pertama ciptaan Brahma adalah juga Kematian, kekuatan jahat yang membawa keseimbangan bagi alam semesta dan mencegahnya penuh sesak.
claims.quote: In another myth Brahma's first female is also Death, the evil force that brings balance to the universe and which ensures there is no over-crowding of it.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma originally had five heads, but when he lusted after his daughter Sandhya an outraged Shiva cut off the head that had ogled the goddess (or burned it with his central eye).
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, semula Brahma berkepala lima, tetapi ketika ia menginginkan putrinya Sandhya, Siwa yang murka memenggal kepala yang menatap sang dewi (atau membakarnya dengan mata tengahnya).
claims.quote: Originally Brahma had five heads but when he lusted after his daughter Sandhya an outraged Shiva cut off the head which had ogled the goddess (or burned it with his central eye).

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is often shown in red with four heads, symbolic of his creation of the four Vedas, and so is often called Caturanana or Caturmukha, "four-faced", and Astakarna, "eight-eared".
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sering digambarkan berwarna merah dengan empat kepala, lambang penciptaan empat Weda; karena itu ia sering disebut Caturanana atau Caturmukha, "berwajah empat", dan Astakarna, "bertelinga delapan".
claims.quote: Brahma is often represented in red with four heads, symbolic of his creation of the four Vedas. Thus he is often called Caturanana/Caturmukha or 'four-faced' and Astakarna or 'eight-eared'.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Cambodian art Brahma, known as Prah Prohm, is again shown with four heads and often riding the sacred goose, the hamsa.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Kamboja Brahma, yang dikenal sebagai Prah Prohm, kembali digambarkan berkepala empat dan sering menunggang angsa suci hamsa.
claims.quote: In Cambodian art, Brahma - known as Prah Prohm - is again represented with four heads and often riding a sacred goose, the hamsa

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Tibet Brahma is known as Tshangs-pa or White Brahma (Tshangs-pa dkar-po) and often rides a horse and carries a white bull and a sword.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, di Tibet Brahma dikenal sebagai Tshangs-pa atau Brahma Putih (Tshangs-pa dkar-po), sering menunggang kuda dan membawa banteng putih dan pedang.
claims.quote: In Tibet, where Brahma is known as Tshangs-pa or White Brahma (Tshangs-pa dkar-po), he often rides a horse and carries a white bull and a sword.

claims.statement: According to the Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation), the Self-existent, desiring to produce beings from his own body, first created the waters with a thought and placed his seed in them; the seed became a golden egg as bright as the sun, and in it he himself was born as Brahman, the progenitor of the whole world.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler), sang Svayambhu, ingin menghasilkan makhluk dari tubuhnya, pertama-tama dengan pikiran menciptakan air dan menaruh benihnya di dalamnya; benih itu menjadi telur emas secemerlang matahari, dan di dalamnya ia sendiri lahir sebagai Brahman, leluhur seluruh dunia.
claims.quote: He, desiring to produce beings of many kinds from his own body, first with a thought created the waters, and placed his seed in them. ... That (seed) became a golden egg, in brilliancy equal to the sun; in that (egg) he himself was born as Brahman, the progenitor of the whole world.

claims.statement: According to the Laws of Manu, the divine one stayed in the egg for a whole year, then by his thought alone divided it into two halves, and out of the halves formed heaven and earth, the middle sphere between them, the eight points of the horizon and the eternal abode of the waters.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hukum Manu, sang ilahi tinggal di dalam telur itu selama setahun penuh, lalu dengan pikirannya sendiri membelahnya menjadi dua bagian, dan dari kedua belahan itu ia membentuk langit dan bumi, ruang tengah di antaranya, delapan penjuru, dan tempat abadi air.
claims.quote: The divine one resided in that egg during a whole year, then he himself by his thought (alone) divided it into two halves; ... And out of those two halves he formed heaven and earth, between them the middle sphere, the eight points of the horizon, and the eternal abode of the waters.

claims.statement: According to the Laws of Manu, one thousand ages of the gods make one day of Brahman, and his night has the same length.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hukum Manu, seribu zaman para dewa berjumlah satu hari Brahman, dan malamnya sama panjang.
claims.quote: But know that the sum of one thousand ages of the gods (makes) one day of Brahman, and that his night has the same length.

claims.statement: According to the Laws of Manu, at the end of that day and night he who was asleep awakes and, after awaking, creates mind, which is both real and unreal.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hukum Manu, pada akhir siang dan malam itu ia yang tertidur terbangun dan setelah bangun menciptakan pikiran, yang sekaligus nyata dan tidak nyata.
claims.quote: At the end of that day and night he who was asleep, awakes and, after awaking, creates mind, which is both real and unreal.

claims.statement: According to the Laws of Manu, the Manvantaras, the creations and destructions of the world, are numberless; sporting, as it were, Brahman repeats this again and again.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hukum Manu, manvantara, penciptaan dan penghancuran dunia, tak terhitung jumlahnya; seolah bermain-main, Brahman mengulangi hal ini berulang kali.
claims.quote: The Manvantaras, the creations and destructions (of the world, are) numberless; sporting, as it were, Brahman repeats this again and again.

claims.statement: According to the Laws of Manu, this universe existed in the shape of Darkness, unperceived, without distinctive marks, unattainable by reasoning, unknowable, wholly immersed as if in deep sleep.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hukum Manu, alam semesta ini semula berwujud Kegelapan, tak terindra, tanpa ciri pembeda, tak terjangkau nalar, tak terpahami, seakan terbenam sepenuhnya dalam tidur lelap.
claims.quote: This (universe) existed in the shape of Darkness, unperceived, destitute of distinctive marks, unattainable by reasoning, unknowable, wholly immersed, as it were, in deep sleep.

claims.statement: In contemporary Hinduism Brahma does not enjoy popular worship and has substantially less importance than the other two members of the Trimurti.
claims.statement_id: Dalam agama Hindu masa kini, Brahma tidak menikmati pemujaan populer dan jauh lebih kecil kepentingannya daripada dua anggota Trimurti lainnya.
claims.quote: In contemporary Hinduism, Brahma does not enjoy popular worship and has substantially less importance than the other two members of the Trimurti.
