issues.message: Keterkaitan otomatis: nama berkas, deskripsi berkas, kategori "Aphrodite of Cnidus -Inv. 8619 (Rome, Palazzo Altemps)", dipakai di bcl.wikipedia.org: Aphrodite. Cek visual tetap diperlukan.

claims.statement: Aphrodite is the ancient Greek goddess of love and beauty with cult centres at Cythera, Cyprus, Corinth and Athens, where the Aphrodisia honoured her yearly; in Laconia she was a warrior goddess.
claims.statement_id: Afrodit adalah dewi Yunani kuno cinta dan kecantikan dengan pusat pemujaan di Kythera, Siprus, Korintus, dan Athena, tempat ia dirayakan setiap tahun dalam festival Aphrodisia; di Lakonia ia dipuja sebagai dewi perang.
claims.quote: is an ancient Greek goddess associated with love and beauty. Aphrodite's main cult centers were Cythera, Cyprus, Corinth, and Athens. In Athens, she was celebrated annually during the Aphrodisia festival. In Laconia, Aphrodite was worshipped as a warrior goddess.

claims.statement: She was known as Cytherea (Lady of Cythera) and Cypris (Lady of Cyprus) because both places claimed to be the site of her birth; the origins of Aphrodite have been the subject of scholarly debate.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikenal sebagai Cytherea (Nyonya Kythera) dan Cypris (Nyonya Siprus) karena kedua tempat itu sama-sama mengaku sebagai tempat kelahirannya; asal-usul Aphrodite menjadi bahan perdebatan para ahli.
claims.quote: Thus she was known as Cytherea (Lady of Cythera) and Cypris (Lady of Cyprus), because both places claimed to be the site of her birth. The origins of Aphrodite have been the subject of scholarly debate.

claims.statement: In Homer's Iliad she is the daughter of Zeus and Dione; in Hesiod's Theogony she is born from the foam produced by Uranus's genitals, which his son Cronus had severed and thrown into the sea; in the Odyssey Aphrodite was married to Hephaestus.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Iliad karya Homer ia putri Zeus dan Dione; dalam Theogony karya Hesiod ia lahir dari buih yang dihasilkan kelamin Uranus yang dipotong dan dilemparkan ke laut oleh putranya, Kronos; dalam Odyssey Aphrodite menikah dengan Hephaestus.
claims.quote: In Homer's Iliad, she is the daughter of Zeus and Dione. In Hesiod's Theogony she is born from the foam ... produced by Uranus's genitals, which his son Cronus had severed and thrown into the sea. In the Odyssey, Aphrodite was married to Hephaestus

claims.statement: Along with Athena and Hera, she was one of the three goddesses whose feud resulted in the Trojan War.
claims.statement_id: Bersama Athena dan Hera, ia salah satu dari tiga dewi yang perselisihannya berujung pada Perang Troya.
claims.quote: Along with Athena and Hera, she was one of the three goddesses whose feud resulted in the Trojan War

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Aphrodite was the Olympian goddess of love, beauty, pleasure and procreation, depicted as a beautiful woman often accompanied by the winged godling Eros (Love); her attributes included a dove, apple, scallop shell and mirror.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Aphrodite adalah dewi Olimpus cinta, kecantikan, kesenangan, dan keturunan, digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik yang sering ditemani dewa kecil bersayap Eros (Cinta); atributnya meliputi merpati, apel, kerang, dan cermin.
claims.quote: APHRODITE was the Olympian goddess of love, beauty, pleasure and procreation. She was depicted as a beautiful woman often accompanied by the winged godling Eros (Love). Her attributes included a dove, apple, scallop shell and mirror.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite was worshipped by men, women and city-state officials, played a role in the commerce, warfare and politics of ancient Greek cities, and was honoured as a protector of those who travelled by sea.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite dipuja oleh pria, wanita, dan pejabat negara-kota, juga berperan dalam perdagangan, peperangan, dan politik kota-kota Yunani kuno, serta dihormati sebagai pelindung mereka yang bepergian lewat laut.
claims.quote: Worshipped by men, women, and city-state officials, Aphrodite also played a role in the commerce, warfare, and politics of ancient Greek cities. In addition, Aphrodite was honoured as a protector of those who travelled by sea

claims.statement: Her name in Greek script is Ἀφροδίτη (Aphrodítē).
claims.statement_id: Namanya dalam aksara Yunani adalah Ἀφροδίτη (Aphrodítē).
claims.quote: Ἀφροδίτη, romanized: Aphrodítē

claims.statement: Hesiod derives the name Aphrodite from aphrós (ἀφρός) "sea-foam", interpreting it as "risen from the foam", but most modern scholars regard this as a spurious folk etymology.
claims.statement_id: Hesiod menurunkan nama Aphrodite dari aphrós (ἀφρός) "buih laut", dan mengartikannya "bangkit dari buih", tetapi sebagian besar ahli modern menganggapnya etimologi rakyat yang keliru.
claims.quote: Hesiod derives the name Aphrodite from aphrós (ἀφρός ) 'sea-foam', interpreting the name as "risen from the foam", but most modern scholars regard this as a spurious folk etymology.

claims.statement: Aphrodite's name is generally accepted as probably of Semitic origin, owing to the believed Near Eastern origins of her worship, but its exact derivation cannot be determined with confidence.
claims.statement_id: Nama Aphrodite umumnya diterima kemungkinan berasal dari bahasa Semit karena diyakini pemujaannya berasal dari Timur Dekat, tetapi asal pastinya tidak dapat dipastikan dengan yakin.
claims.quote: Aphrodite's name is generally accepted to likely be of Semitic origin, due to the believed Near Eastern origins of Aphrodite's worship, but its exact derivation cannot be determined with confidence.

claims.statement: Proposed influences on her origins have included Near Eastern love goddesses, an indigenous Cypriot goddess, and a Proto-Indo-European dawn goddess.
claims.statement_id: Pengaruh yang diusulkan atas asal-usulnya mencakup dewi cinta Timur Dekat, dewi asli Siprus, dan dewi fajar Proto-Indo-Eropa.
claims.quote: Proposed influences on her origins have included Near Eastern love goddesses, an indigenous Cypriot goddess, and a Proto-Indo-European dawn goddess.

claims.statement: Some scholars believe the cult of Aphrodite in Greece was influenced by the cult of Astarte in Phoenicia, which was in turn influenced by the cult of the Mesopotamian goddess known as "Ishtar" to the East Semitic peoples and "Inanna" to the Sumerians.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian ahli yakin bahwa pemujaan Aphrodite di Yunani dipengaruhi pemujaan Astarte di Fenisia, yang pada gilirannya dipengaruhi pemujaan dewi Mesopotamia yang dikenal sebagai "Ishtar" oleh bangsa Semit Timur dan "Inanna" oleh bangsa Sumer.
claims.quote: Some scholars believe that the cult of Aphrodite in Greece was influenced by the cult of Astarte in Phoenicia, which, in turn, was influenced by the cult of the Mesopotamian goddess known as "Ishtar" to the East Semitic peoples and as "Inanna" to the Sumerians.

claims.statement: Most modern scholars now reject the idea of a purely Indo-European Aphrodite, but it is possible that Aphrodite, who may have originated as a Semitic deity, was influenced by the Indo-European dawn goddess.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian besar ahli modern kini menolak gagasan Aphrodite yang murni Indo-Eropa, tetapi mungkin Aphrodite, yang barangkali berasal dari dewa Semit, dipengaruhi dewi fajar Indo-Eropa.
claims.quote: Most modern scholars have now rejected the notion of a purely Indo-European Aphrodite, but it is possible that Aphrodite, who may have originated as an Semitic deity, was influenced by the Indo-European dawn goddess.

claims.statement: Like Inanna-Ishtar, Aphrodite was a warrior goddess; the second-century AD Greek geographer Pausanias records that in Sparta Aphrodite was worshipped as Aphrodite Areia, meaning "warlike".
claims.statement_id: Seperti Inanna-Ishtar, Aphrodite adalah dewi pejuang; geografer Yunani abad ke-2 M, Pausanias, mencatat bahwa di Sparta Aphrodite dipuja sebagai Aphrodite Areia, yang berarti "bersifat perang".
claims.quote: Like Inanna-Ishtar, Aphrodite was a warrior goddess; the second-century AD Greek geographer Pausanias records that, in Sparta, Aphrodite was worshipped as Aphrodite Areia, which means "warlike".

claims.statement: Aphrodite's most common cultic epithet was Ourania, "heavenly", which almost never occurs in literary texts and so had a purely cultic significance; another common name was Pandemos ("For All the Folk").
claims.statement_id: Julukan kultus Aphrodite yang paling umum adalah Ourania, "surgawi", yang hampir tidak pernah muncul dalam teks sastra sehingga bermakna murni kultus; nama umum lainnya adalah Pandemos ("Bagi Seluruh Rakyat").
claims.quote: Aphrodite's most common cultic epithet was Ourania, meaning "heavenly", but this epithet almost never occurs in literary texts, indicating a purely cultic significance. Another common name for Aphrodite was Pandemos ("For All the Folk").

claims.statement: Paphian (Παφία) was one of her epithets, after Paphos in Cyprus where she had emerged from the sea at her birth.
claims.statement_id: Paphian (Παφία) adalah salah satu julukannya, menurut Paphos di Siprus tempat ia muncul dari laut saat lahir.
claims.quote: Paphian (Παφία), was one of her epithets, after the Paphos in Cyprus where she had emerged from the sea at her birth.

claims.statement: In Athens the Aphrodisia was celebrated on the fourth day of the month of Hekatombaion in honour of Aphrodite's role in the unification of Attica.
claims.statement_id: Di Athena, Aphrodisia dirayakan pada hari keempat bulan Hekatombaion untuk menghormati peran Aphrodite dalam penyatuan Attika.
claims.quote: In Athens, the Aphrodisia was celebrated on the fourth day of the month of Hekatombaion in honor of Aphrodite's role in the unification of Attica.

claims.statement: The ancient Romans identified Aphrodite with their goddess Venus, who was originally a goddess of agricultural fertility, vegetation and springtime.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Romawi kuno menyamakan Aphrodite dengan dewi mereka Venus, yang semula dewi kesuburan pertanian, tumbuh-tumbuhan, dan musim semi.
claims.quote: The ancient Romans identified Aphrodite with their goddess Venus, who was originally a goddess of agricultural fertility, vegetation, and springtime.

claims.statement: According to the Roman historian Livy, Aphrodite and Venus were officially identified in the third century BC when the cult of Venus Erycina was introduced to Rome from the Greek sanctuary of Aphrodite on Mount Eryx in Sicily.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sejarawan Romawi Livius, Aphrodite dan Venus secara resmi disamakan pada abad ke-3 SM ketika pemujaan Venus Erycina dibawa ke Roma dari tempat suci Aphrodite Yunani di Gunung Eryx di Sisilia.
claims.quote: According to the Roman historian Livy, Aphrodite and Venus were officially identified in the third century BC when the cult of Venus Erycina was introduced to Rome from the Greek sanctuary of Aphrodite on Mount Eryx in Sicily.

claims.statement: Because Aphrodite was the mother of the Trojan hero Aeneas in Greek mythology and Roman tradition claimed Aeneas as founder of Rome, Venus came to be venerated as Venus Genetrix, mother of the entire Roman nation.
claims.statement_id: Karena Aphrodite adalah ibu pahlawan Troya Aeneas dalam mitologi Yunani dan tradisi Romawi menyebut Aeneas pendiri Roma, Venus dipuja sebagai Venus Genetrix, ibu seluruh bangsa Romawi.
claims.quote: Because Aphrodite was the mother of the Trojan hero Aeneas in Greek mythology and the Roman tradition claimed Aeneas as the founder of Rome, Venus became venerated as Venus Genetrix, the mother of the entire Roman nation.

claims.statement: In the Iliad Aphrodite is the apparently unmarried consort of Ares, god of war, and the wife of Hephaestus is a different goddess named Charis; in Hesiod's Theogony Aphrodite is unmarried and the wife of Hephaestus is Aglaea, the youngest of the three Charites.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Iliad, Aphrodite adalah pasangan Ares sang dewa perang yang tampaknya belum menikah, dan istri Hephaestus adalah dewi lain bernama Charis; dalam Theogony karya Hesiod, Aphrodite tidak menikah dan istri Hephaestus adalah Aglaea, yang bungsu dari tiga Charites.
claims.quote: In the Iliad, Aphrodite is the apparently unmarried consort of Ares, the god of war, and the wife of Hephaestus is a different goddess named Charis. In Hesiod's Theogony, Aphrodite is unmarried and the wife of Hephaestus is Aglaea, the youngest of the three Charites.

claims.statement: In the Odyssey, the blind singer Demodocus describes Aphrodite as the wife of Hephaestus and tells how she committed adultery with Ares during the Trojan War.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Odyssey, penyanyi buta Demodokos menggambarkan Aphrodite sebagai istri Hephaestus dan menceritakan bagaimana ia berzina dengan Ares semasa Perang Troya.
claims.quote: In the Odyssey, the blind singer Demodocus describes Aphrodite as the wife of Hephaestus and tells how she committed adultery with Ares during the Trojan War.

claims.statement: In later sources it was generally Ares who was regarded as the goddess's husband or official consort, as on the François Vase, a sixth-century BC krater, and in the poetry of Pindar and Aeschylus.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sumber-sumber kemudian, Ares umumnya dianggap suami atau pasangan resmi sang dewi, misalnya pada Vas François, sebuah krater abad ke-6 SM, dan dalam puisi Pindaros dan Aiskhylos.
claims.quote: In later sources, it was generally Ares who was regarded as the husband or official consort of the goddess, such as on the François Vase, a sixth-century BC krater, and in the poetry of Pindar and Aeschylus.

claims.statement: Aphrodite is almost always accompanied by Eros, the personification of love; Eros is often seen as Aphrodite's son.
claims.statement_id: Aphrodite hampir selalu ditemani Eros, personifikasi cinta; Eros sering dipandang sebagai putra Aphrodite.
claims.quote: Aphrodite is almost always accompanied by Eros, the personification of love. ... Eros is often seen as Aphrodite's son.

claims.statement: The First Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite (Hymn 5), probably composed in the mid-seventh century BC, describes how Zeus, annoyed with Aphrodite for making deities fall in love with mortals, made her fall in love with Anchises, a handsome mortal shepherd living in the foothills beneath Mount Ida near the city of Troy.
claims.statement_id: Himne Homerik Pertama untuk Aphrodite (Himne 5), yang kemungkinan digubah sekitar pertengahan abad ke-7 SM, menceritakan bagaimana Zeus kesal karena Aphrodite membuat para dewa jatuh cinta pada manusia fana, sehingga ia membuat Aphrodite jatuh cinta pada Anchises, gembala fana yang tampan yang tinggal di kaki Gunung Ida dekat kota Troya.
claims.quote: The First Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite (Hymn 5), which was probably composed sometime in the mid-seventh century BC, describes how Zeus once became annoyed with Aphrodite for causing deities to fall in love with mortals, so he caused her to fall in love with Anchises, a handsome mortal shepherd who lived in the foothills beneath Mount Ida near the city of Troy.

claims.statement: Aphrodite's most prominent avian symbol was the dove, originally a symbol of her Near Eastern precursor Inanna-Ishtar.
claims.statement_id: Lambang burung Aphrodite yang paling menonjol adalah merpati, yang semula lambang pendahulunya dari Timur Dekat, Inanna-Ishtar.
claims.quote: Aphrodite's most prominent avian symbol was the dove, originally a symbol of her Near Eastern precursor Inanna-Ishtar.

claims.statement: Around 364/361 BC the Athenian sculptor Praxiteles carved the marble statue Aphrodite of Knidos, which Pliny the Elder later praised as the greatest sculpture ever made.
claims.statement_id: Sekitar 364/361 SM, pemahat Athena Praxiteles memahat arca marmer Aphrodite dari Knidos, yang kemudian dipuji Plinius Tua sebagai patung terbesar yang pernah dibuat.
claims.quote: In c. 364/361 BC, the Athenian sculptor Praxiteles carved the marble statue Aphrodite of Knidos, which Pliny the Elder later praised as the greatest sculpture ever made.

claims.statement: In cinema, the symbolism of the goddess of love has been central to William A. Seiter's 1948 film One Touch of Venus starring Ava Gardner and to Woody Allen's 1995 film Mighty Aphrodite.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sinema, simbolisme dewi cinta menjadi pusat film One Touch of Venus (1948) karya William A. Seiter yang dibintangi Ava Gardner, dan film Mighty Aphrodite (1995) karya Woody Allen.
claims.quote: In cinema, the symbolism of the goddess of love has been central to William A. Seiter's 1948 film One Touch of Venus starring Ava Gardner, and to Woody Allen's 1995 film Mighty Aphrodite.

claims.statement: In 1938 Gleb Botkin, a Russian immigrant to the United States, founded the Church of Aphrodite, a neopagan religion that worships a mother goddess identified by its practitioners as Aphrodite.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1938, Gleb Botkin, imigran Rusia di Amerika Serikat, mendirikan Church of Aphrodite, agama neopagan yang memuja dewi ibu yang oleh para penganutnya diidentifikasi sebagai Aphrodite.
claims.quote: In 1938, Gleb Botkin, a Russian immigrant to the United States, founded the Church of Aphrodite, a neopagan religion that worships a mother goddess, identified by its practitioners as Aphrodite.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Hippolytos was destroyed by the goddess for scorning her worship.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Hippolytos dihancurkan sang dewi karena meremehkan pemujaannya.
claims.quote: The death of Hippolytos, who was destroyed by the goddess for scorning her worship.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Pygmalion's statue was brought to life by Aphrodite in answer to his prayers.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, arca Pygmalion dihidupkan oleh Aphrodite sebagai jawaban atas doanya.
claims.quote: The statue of Pygmalion which was brought to life by Aphrodite in answer to his prayers.

claims.statement: According to theoi.com, Aphrodite persecuted Psykhe (Psyche), the maiden loved by her son Eros.
claims.statement_id: Menurut theoi.com, Aphrodite menganiaya Psykhe (Psyche), gadis yang dicintai putranya, Eros.
claims.quote: The persecution of Psykhe (Psyche), the maiden loved by the goddess' son Eros.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, later traditions call her a daughter of Kronos and Euonyme, or of Uranus and Hemera.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, tradisi yang lebih kemudian menyebutnya putri Kronos dan Euonyme, atau Uranus dan Hemera.
claims.quote: Later traditions call her a daughter of Kronos and Euonyme, or of Uranus and Hemera.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, apart from the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite there is no trace of the foam legend in Homer, who makes Aphrodite the daughter of Zeus and Dione.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, selain pada Himne Homerik untuk Aphrodite tidak ada jejak legenda buih ini dalam Homer, yang menyebut Aphrodite putri Zeus dan Dione.
claims.quote: With the exception of the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite there is no trace of this legend in Homer, and according to him Aphrodite is the daughter of Zeus and Dione.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod and the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite, the goddess after rising from the foam first approached the island of Cythera and from there went to Cyprus.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod dan Himne Homerik untuk Aphrodite, setelah bangkit dari buih sang dewi pertama-tama mendekati Pulau Kythera, lalu pergi ke Siprus.
claims.quote: According to Hesiod and the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite, the goddess after rising from the foam first approached the island of Cythera, and thence went to Cyprus

claims.statement: According to cosmogonic views of Aphrodite's nature, she was the personification of the generative powers of nature and the mother of all living beings.
claims.statement_id: Menurut pandangan kosmogonik tentang hakikat Aphrodite, ia adalah personifikasi daya penghasil alam dan ibu semua makhluk hidup.
claims.quote: According to the cosmogonic views of the nature of Aphrodite, she was the personification of the generative powers of nature, and the mother of all living beings.

claims.statement: In the contest of Typhon with the gods, Aphrodite metamorphosed herself into a fish.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pertarungan Typhon dengan para dewa, Aphrodite mengubah dirinya menjadi ikan.
claims.quote: in the contest of Typhon with the gods, Aphrodite metamorphosed herself into a fish

claims.statement: According to the popular belief of the Greeks, she was the goddess of love who excited this passion in the hearts of gods and men and by this power ruled over all living creation.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan populer orang Yunani, Aphrodite adalah dewi cinta yang membangkitkan gairah itu di hati para dewa dan manusia, dan dengan kekuatan ini ia berkuasa atas seluruh makhluk hidup.
claims.quote: she was the goddess of love, who excited this passion in the hearts of gods and men, and by this power ruled over all the living creation.

claims.statement: Ancient mythology furnishes numerous instances in which Aphrodite punished those who neglected her worship or despised her power, and others in which she favoured and protected those who did homage to her and recognized her sway.
claims.statement_id: Mitologi kuno memuat banyak contoh Aphrodite menghukum mereka yang mengabaikan pemujaannya atau meremehkan kekuasaannya, juga contoh ia menyukai dan melindungi mereka yang memuliakannya dan mengakui kekuasaannya.
claims.quote: Ancient mythology furnishes numerous instances in which Aphrodite punished those who neglected her worship or despised her power, as well as others in which she favoured and protected those who did homage to her and recognized her sway.

claims.statement: She also had the power of granting beauty and invincible charms to others.
claims.statement_id: Aphrodite juga memiliki kuasa untuk menganugerahkan kecantikan dan pesona yang tak tertahankan kepada orang lain.
claims.quote: she had further the power of granting beauty and invincible charms to others.

claims.statement: In the Trojan War, when she tried to rescue her darling Aeneas from the fight, Aphrodite was pursued by Diomedes, who wounded her in her hand.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Perang Troya, ketika ia berusaha menyelamatkan Aeneas kesayangannya dari pertempuran, Aphrodite dikejar Diomedes yang melukai tangannya.
claims.quote: when she endeavoured to rescue her darling Aeneas from the fight, she was pursued by Diomedes, who wounded her in her hand.

claims.statement: By Ares she became the mother of Phobos, Deimos and Harmonia, and, according to later traditions, of Eros and Anteros also.
claims.statement_id: Dari Ares, Aphrodite menjadi ibu Phobos, Deimos, Harmonia, dan menurut tradisi yang lebih kemudian juga Eros dan Anteros.
claims.quote: By Ares she became the mother of Phobos, Deimos, Harmonia, and, according to later traditions, of Eros and Anteros also.

claims.statement: Aphrodite conceived an invincible passion for Anchises, by whom she became the mother of Aeneas and Lyrus.
claims.statement_id: Aphrodite dilanda hasrat tak tertahankan pada Anchises, yang darinya ia menjadi ibu Aeneas dan Lyrus.
claims.quote: Aphrodite conceived an invincible passion for Anchises, by whom she became the mother of Aeneas and Lyrus.

claims.statement: At the wedding of Peleus and Thetis, Eris (goddess of strife) offered a golden apple for the most beautiful goddess; Hera, Athena and Aphrodite vied for the honour and Zeus appointed the Trojan prince Paris as judge.
claims.statement_id: Pada pernikahan Peleus dan Thetis, Eris (dewi perselisihan) menawarkan apel emas bagi dewi tercantik; Hera, Athena, dan Aphrodite berebut kehormatan itu dan Zeus menunjuk pangeran Troya, Paris, sebagai hakim.
claims.quote: At the wedding of Peleus and Thetis, Eris (goddess of strife) offered a golden apple for the most beautiful goddess. Hera, Athena, and Aphrodite vied for the honour, and Zeus appointed the Trojan prince Paris as judge.

claims.statement: Aphrodite offered the most beautiful woman in the world; Paris chose Aphrodite and the victorious goddess gave him fair Helen of Sparta.
claims.statement_id: Aphrodite menawarkan perempuan tercantik di dunia; Paris memilih Aphrodite sehingga sang dewi pemenang memberinya Helena dari Sparta yang jelita.
claims.quote: Aphrodite offered the most beautiful woman in the world. Paris chose Aphrodite and so the victorious goddess gave him fair Helen of Sparta.

claims.statement: In notable episodes Aphrodite protects her son Aeneas from Diomedes and saves the hapless Paris from the wrath of Menelaos.
claims.statement_id: Dalam episode-episode penting, Aphrodite melindungi putranya Aeneas dari Diomedes dan menyelamatkan Paris yang malang dari murka Menelaos.
claims.quote: In notable episodes, Aphrodite protects her son Aeneas from Diomedes and saves the hapless Paris from the wrath of Menelaos.

claims.statement: One of the goddess's most famous flings was with the beautiful Adonis; Aphrodite kept the youth in a chest guarded by Persephone, who fell in love with him too and would not give him back, so Zeus intervened and ruled that Adonis spend four months of the year with each lady.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu hubungan Aphrodite yang paling terkenal adalah dengan Adonis yang rupawan; Aphrodite menyimpan pemuda itu di dalam peti yang dijaga Persephone, tetapi Persephone pun jatuh cinta dan tak mau mengembalikannya, sehingga Zeus turun tangan dan memutuskan Adonis tinggal empat bulan setahun bersama masing-masing dewi.
claims.quote: One of the goddess' most famous flings was with the beautiful Adonis. Aphrodite kept the youth safely in a chest guarded by Persephone, but the latter fell in love with him too and would not give him back to the goddess of love. Zeus was obliged to intervene, and he ruled that Adonis should spend four months of the year with each lady

claims.statement: Aphrodite was distraught at her loss, and her grief was commemorated in a cult whose annual highlight was a women-only festival, the Adonia.
claims.statement_id: Aphrodite sangat berduka atas kehilangan Adonis, dan dukanya diperingati dalam sebuah kultus yang puncak tahunannya adalah festival khusus perempuan, Adonia.
claims.quote: Aphrodite was distraught at her loss, and her grief was commemorated in a cult, the annual highlight of which was a women-only festival, the Adonia.

claims.statement: In Archaic and Classical art she is usually clothed and wears an elaborately embroidered band or girdle across her chest which held her magic powers of love, desire and seductive allurement.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Arkaik dan Klasik ia biasanya berpakaian dan mengenakan pita atau ikat pinggang bersulam rumit melintang di dadanya, yang menyimpan kekuatan ajaibnya akan cinta, hasrat, dan daya pikat.
claims.quote: She is usually clothed in Archaic and Classical art and wears an elaborately embroidered band or girdle across her chest which held her magic powers of love, desire, and seductive allurement.

claims.statement: The goddess is often identified by one or more of the following: a mirror, an apple, a myrtle wreath, a sacred bird or dove, a sceptre and a flower.
claims.statement_id: Sang dewi sering dikenali dari satu atau lebih benda berikut: cermin, apel, karangan myrtus, burung suci atau merpati, tongkat kerajaan, dan bunga.
claims.quote: The goddess is often identified with one or more of the following: a mirror, an apple, a myrtle wreath, a sacred bird or dove, a sceptre, and a flower.

claims.statement: Hesiod describes the goddess as "quick-glancing", "foam-born", "smile-loving", and most often as "golden Aphrodite".
claims.statement_id: Hesiod menggambarkan sang dewi sebagai "bermata cepat", "lahir dari buih", "pencinta senyum", dan paling sering sebagai "Aphrodite yang keemasan".
claims.quote: Hesiod describes the goddess as 'quick-glancing', 'foam-born', 'smile-loving', and most often as 'golden Aphrodite'.

claims.statement: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite was married to the lame god Hephaistos, master of fire and crafts.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite menikah dengan dewa pincang Hephaistos, penguasa api dan kerajinan.
claims.quote: Aphrodite was married to the lame god Hephaistos, master of fire and crafts.
